scripts.query: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS investigations

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS investigations.records ( `time` DateTime64(9, 'UTC') CODEC(Delta, ZSTD), `event` JSON COMMENT 'tenzir:catch_all' CODEC(ZSTD(3)) ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/{installation}/{cluster}/tables/{shard}/investigations/records', '{replica}') PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(time) ORDER BY (time) SETTINGS storage_policy = 'tiered', ttl_only_drop_parts = 1
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ocsf

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ocsf.Base_Event ( `time` DateTime64(9, 'UTC') CODEC(Delta, ZSTD), `class_uid` Int32 DEFAULT 0, `class_name` LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), `activity_id` Nullable(Int8), `severity_id` Int8 DEFAULT 0, `metadata.product.name` LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), `device.hostname` LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), `unmapped` JSON CODEC(ZSTD(3)), `event` JSON COMMENT 'tenzir:catch_all' CODEC(ZSTD(3)) ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/{installation}/{cluster}/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') PARTITION BY toDate(`time`) ORDER BY (class_uid, `time`) TTL `time` + INTERVAL 90 DAY TO VOLUME 'cold', `time` + INTERVAL 400 DAY DELETE SETTINGS storage_policy = 'tiered', ttl_only_drop_parts = 1
